paragraphs: Polopi bar Peruta. Before R' Yonah: Jerusalem Talmud, Ta'anit [י in the source], 4:3; Megillah 1:1:11: R' Pelupa. In Megillah 4:2:2: Pilpi bar Peruti before R' Yonah; and Massekhet Soferim chapters 1 and 21. R' Mana was before him [compact clause; attachment provisional]. He raised an objection to R' Ze'ira in Ta'anit 4:3:2. R' Pilipi said to R' Nehorai: Bereshit Rabbah, Vayetze 71:9.
